title: SP638 bounded hairpin corridor cut/fill proof
hypothesis: A bounded ~700 m maximum-curvature SP638 slice using Unreal editor spline raise/lower deformation plus a separate neutral road/shoulder proof surface will remove road-ground clipping and materially improve rider-height readability without rebuilding the full Passo Giau terrain.
technical: Reuse the persisted L_PassoGiauTerrainSpike.umap instead of redownloading the full Veneto DTM source.
Select the proof slice deterministically from SP638 curvature.
Use LandscapeProxy.editor_apply_spline with both raise_heights and lower_heights enabled.
Keep all Landscape deformation transient and unsaved.
keep: Official Veneto SP638 centerline and persisted spline.
reject: Global Landscape-resolution increases as the next response to the R4.1B.1 visual failure.
Asset dressing before road/terrain geometry is visually coherent.
learnings: Epic supports spline-driven raise/lower Landscape deformation with falloff.
Road tooling such as RoadBuilder separates road and ground responsibilities.
Community failure reports justify retaining a visual gate even when raise/lower deformation is enabled.
next: Run the bounded hairpin proof and classify it as TECHNICAL_PASS + human visual result.
If visually accepted, promote bounded corridor authoring; otherwise move to Landscape Patch/generated ground mesh rather than larger global heightfields.
